geography.basis: Reported localities and a later satellite scar give documentary context. Neither supplies registered minute positions or an Atlas geographic replay.

appearance.basis: The linked tornado photograph supplies documentary visual context. Its inspection record does not establish a registered camera, clock or appearance interval.

damage.basis: Building cases and aftermath images describe surveyed or reported outcomes. Surviving areas do not establish who sheltered there, and a failure interpretation is not a timed observation of collapse.

gaps.basis: The storm photograph inception-field conflict, unverified aftermath and housing clocks, and the radar report conversion inconsistency remain separate attributed records. None changes the admitted NWS documentary chronology.
